---
description: In files, code, comments and documents do not use the em dash, arrows, emoji and other symbols a human normally does not type
---

Do not use the em dash (—), arrows (→), emoji, typographic quotes («» and similar), or a one-character ellipsis. Use ASCII: `-`, `->`, `"`, `'`, `...`.

**Exceptions:** symbols are allowed in chat replies when the user explicitly allowed them or when they already exist in the text the agent works with.

**Why:** symbols reveal text generated by an AI.
